The Subtask Name: Determine Sergio Osmeña's birthplace

- Agent: WebSurfer

  -- Observation: Found snippets from INQUIRER.net ("born in Cebu City, Philippines") and Wikipedia ("Cebu, Cebu, Captaincy General of the Philippines"). Britannica link visible but content not fully extracted.
  -- Thought: Multiple sources indicate Cebu City, but need to confirm with Britannica specifically.
  -- Result: Reported search results showing Cebu City as birthplace from INQUIRER and Wikipedia; noted Britannica link.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed search results showing Cebu City as birthplace but lacking direct Britannica citation.
  -- Observation: INQUIRER and Wikipedia confirm Cebu City; Britannica link present but not accessed.
  -- Thought: Need to explicitly access Britannica to get authoritative citation.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to search for "Sergio Osmeña birthplace Britannica".
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched for "Sergio Osmeña birthplace Britannica" on DuckDuckGo.
  -- Observation: Found Britannica link (https://www.britannica.com › biography › Sergio-Osmena) and INQUIRER snippet confirming "Cebu City".
  -- Thought: Britannica is a high-quality source; need to verify if it explicitly states birthplace.
  -- Result: Reported finding Britannica page and INQUIRER confirmation of Cebu City.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed latest search results showing Britannica and INQUIRER both point to Cebu City.
  -- Observation: INQUIRER explicitly states "Cebu City"; Britannica page visible but birthplace text not fully extracted in snippet.
  -- Thought: INQUIRER provides explicit "Cebu City" citation; Britannica likely confirms but needs verification.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to prioritize INQUIRER and Britannica for final citation.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Repeated search for "Sergio Osmeña birthplace" on DuckDuckGo.
  -- Observation: Same results as before: INQUIRER ("Cebu City"), Wikipedia ("Cebu, Cebu"), Britannica link.
  -- Thought: Consistent results across sources; INQUIRER provides clear "Cebu City" statement.
